bio.es: Marta es una mujer completamente entregada a su trabajo, decidida a demostrar que es tan capaz como cualquier hombre. Para abrirse camino en un mundo dominado por ellos, tuvo que convertirse en una persona aparentemente fuerte, reservada y capaz de ocultar sus emociones. Durante mucho tiempo, su vida gira únicamente en torno al trabajo y a satisfacer las expectativas de su familia, relegando sus propios sentimientos a un segundo plano. Todo eso cambia cuando se enamora de Fina. Gracias a ella, el carácter firme e impenetrable de Marta comienza a suavizarse. Por primera vez descubre el amor y, poco a poco, aprende a dar prioridad a sus propios sentimientos y a permitirse vivirlos con libertad.
bio.en: Marta is a woman completely devoted to her work, determined to prove that she is just as capable as any man. To make her way in a world dominated by men, she had to become someone outwardly strong, reserved, and able to hide her emotions. For a long time, her life revolves solely around work and meeting her family's expectations, pushing her own feelings into the background. All of that changes when she falls in love with Fina. Thanks to her, Marta's firm and impenetrable character begins to soften. For the first time she discovers love and, little by little, she learns to put her own feelings first and to allow herself to live them freely.
